cc:Work.dc:title: Availability targets in a 30-day month
cc:Work.dc:description: Minutes = 43,200 × (1 − availability fraction). This is time-based target arithmetic, following Google SRE, not observed outages, a provider SLA, or a prediction. Contractual exclusions and real service measurements may differ.
